qualified: Actual stored geometry is checked before selected-output allocation and compressed-pixel reads. Tiny regions do not bypass the full stored-image cap.
Over-limit descriptions remain available; an admitted smaller child decodes in the same operation after an earlier refusal.

Independent NoPixels source guard is not triggered by limit refusal. An admitted child triggers it; disabling the guard permits exact native sample comparison. Classic/BigTIFF and planar/chunky configurations are exercised.
Pinned TIFF source has no native threading path; Sequential is accepted. Native no-op defaults are accepted by both TIFF/JXL factories.
The documented encode-only output-byte field does not constrain a decode. Nontrivial unqualified fields and mixed supported/unsupported configurations refuse before source reads or length queries.
Each explicit value of each decode-policy flag refuses while no-op defaults succeed. JXL geometry remains explicitly unsupported.
LimitExceeded retains actual and maximum values through the checked error.
not_qualified: Native working memory or process RSS bound.
Input-size, frame-count, animation-duration or total-pixel caps.
JXL geometry resource mappings across presentation, raw layers, hidden/reference reconstruction and replay.
Fallible/infallible allocation-mode enforcement or nontrivial decode policy/PII guarantees.
